entity.description:
Metropolis is the city where Superman lives and calls his home. The city was nearly destroyed by Darkseid. Most areas here are shown in DC comics or movies.

This arena makes its appearance as an arena in Mortal Kombat vs. DC Universe.

Metropolis is one of the largest and wealthiest cities on Earth, and home to both Superman and Lex Luthor. It was also devastated by the merging of the two parallel universes in Mortal Kombat vs. DC Universe, and serves as a place of battle.
